judul_ulasan: Great location, great service, but dated
teks_ulasan: overall, i had a good experience staying here. it is an old hotel, so facilities are dated. but they try to update the interior (flat screen tv, clean bedsheets, new sofa, etc). it is generally clean. i found what-at-first looked like sand near the bedframe, and later i realized they were wood granules. i suspect there may be termites. i booked a business deluxe room. the room was spacious but the table is very small, and has no bath tub. the view from the room (# 119) was bad: a neighbor wall. the location is superb, right in the city center. a walking distance to bip mall and the factory outlet center (jalan riau). the choice of room service menu is very poor. however, when there are so many good restaurants outside the hotel, eating out is easy. the mini bar was very sparsely stocked. if you want to sleep in on weekends, avoid rooms on the first floor, as they are next to the swimming pool which was very crowded with children in the morning. the daily 9 o'clock calls to offer you the spa treatment was a bit annoying. the staff were fantastic: very courteous, respectful and helpful. would i stay there again? probably not.

i chose the hotel for its location, it was placed within walking distance to riau street, one of the most famous street for factory outlet shopping. i see nice modern looking room and facilities pictures. in the morning i receive an email from sales executive of the hotel. the message was very friendly and informative, she even provide me map of bandung. the message said "hotel santika bandung have all been totally renovated, interior or exterior. for the floor we no longer using carpet but now using parquet."the hotel check in is quiet easy, the lobby is great, but the problem start after that. the lift only fit 3 - 4 people, old and smelly. the common area other than lobby also old and smelly. the room are disappointing, more like new finishing furniture, lcd tv about 22" smaller than my computer monitor, the bathroom were not renovated, old bathtub and closet. there was new accessories but it looks cheap and unbranded. how can they say it was totally renovated? and finally surprise, surprise not carpet floor but not parquet floor either. it was ceramics floor with wood motif. ceramics are worst than carpet, its cheaper also, its hard and cold at night. most new hotel in bandung already using marble floor its about 10 times more expensive than ceramics.all in all i tried to like this hotel very much i believe if they didn't give me a misleading information this hotel can be rate as average. but from being misleading - admitting - then didn't say any word afterward.
